description:
## What
Fixes a bug in `ThemeValidator`'s spacing scale consistency check (`packages/theme/src/validators/theme-validator.ts`) discovered via `pnpm test` failing on `main` during daily autohealing.

## Root cause
The geometric-progression check used a truthy guard (`prevValue && currentValue && nextValue`) to decide whether to compute a ratio window. Since `0` is a common/valid spacing baseline, any window anchored on a `0` value was silently skipped — not because of the intended division-by-zero concern, but as a side effect of JS truthiness. Combined with a loose `0.5` tolerance, this meant `theme-validator.test.ts > should treat warnings as errors in strict mode` never received the expected warning for an intentionally inconsistent scale (`0px, 4px, 10px, 20px`).

## Fix
- Replace the truthy guard with explicit `undefined`/`0` checks, so zero-anchored windows are skipped for the right reason (avoiding `x / 0`) rather than by accident.
- Tighten the ratio tolerance from `0.5` to `0.3` so a `2.5x` → `2x` jump is correctly flagged as inconsistent, matching the test's intent.

## Verification
- `pnpm --filter @sparkle/theme test` — 164/164 passing (was 163/164)
- `pnpm test` — full workspace suite green
- `pnpm check` — clean (format + types + monorepo consistency)
- `pnpm build` — clean
